marlowcrystal.config.title: Marlow's Crystal Optimizer
marlowcrystal.config.keep_render.descrip: Keeps a broken crystal visible until the server removes it. The next crystal can still be placed where it stood straight away. If the server did not break it, that placement stops as soon as that is known, and at the latest 30 ticks after the hit, a second and a half at the normal tick rate.
marlowcrystal.config.update_source.descr: Where to look for new versions built for your Minecraft version and mod loader.
marlowcrystal.config.experimental_builds: Also offers beta builds when looking for new versions, not only full releases. Beta builds can still change before they are released.
